## Listing a project in the Hub?

<!-- Delete this section if your pull request doesn't add a project to projects.yml. -->

A bot checks 1 to 6 on GitHub and comments with the result; a person checks 7 within 7 days. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/djazairdev/djazair.dev/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#list-a-project-in-the-hub).

- [ ] 1. An OSI-approved open-source licence
- [ ] 2. At least one commit in the last 90 days
- [ ] 3. A README and a CONTRIBUTING file
- [ ] 4. Issues turned on, with the label `good first issue` or `help wanted`
- [ ] 5. The maintainers pledge to reply to newcomer pull requests within 7 days
- [ ] 6. The repository carries the GitHub topic `djazairdev`
- [ ] 7. Algerian maintainers, or clear relevance to Algeria:  <!-- say which -->
